hero_title: Equitable Healthcare. Early Detection. Healthier Communities.
hero_subtitle: Delivering free diagnostic screenings, subsidized reproductive & maternal care, and emergency infectious disease outreaches to underserved populations across Abuja and Nigerian communities.

pillars.title: Oncology & Tumor Screening
pillars.description: Routine breast and cervical cancer awareness, tumor marker screenings, and early detection campaigns in partnership with POWA and community organizations.

pillars.title: Reproductive Health & Fertility Support
pillars.description: Free pelvic ultrasounds, up to 90%-discounted fertility workups, and subsidized OB/GYN consultations for couples in collaboration with Ronnie Diagnostic Center.

pillars.title: Infectious Disease Control & Malaria
pillars.description: Targeted grassroots medical outreaches, Walk against Malaria initiatives, rapid testing, and distribution of insecticide-treated nets to vulnerable settlements.

pillars.title: IDP & Rural Medical Outreaches
pillars.description: Comprehensive primary healthcare, antenatal scans, and pharmaceutical care for internally displaced persons and hard-to-reach settlements like Durumi IDP Camp.

affiliate_banner.title: In Clinical Affiliation with Ronnie Diagnostic Center, Abuja
affiliate_banner.description: Leveraging state-of-the-art laboratory analysis, ultrasound imaging, and diagnostic equipment to ensure precision clinical standards in every community outreach.
